RUSTFALL

A Rust-inspired survival game for browser + mobile. Single-player prototype with bots — no install, no server.

PC: WASD move • mouse look (click to lock) • LMB hit / shoot • E gather / loot • F eat • 1-6 weapons • Tab bag • B build wall • R rotate • Space/Shift jump / sprint
Mobile: left stick to move • drag right side to look • FIRE / HIT buttons • 🎒 for crafting.
Goal: chop trees 🌲, mine rocks 🪨, loot barrels 🛢, craft hatchet → rifle, raid the central gas station, kill 6 scavenger bots, don't starve.

⚠️ Fan-made prototype inspired by Rust (Facepunch). Not affiliated. Add to home screen on mobile to play like an app (PWA). Progress saves locally.
